text_simplified: This text offers *tarbiyah* (Islamic upbringing) guidance on teaching children the Noble Qur'an and instilling the correct *aqeedah* (creed) in their hearts from a young age. Parents are advised to raise their daughters upon the love of Allah and His Oneness, and to warn them against creedal errors. It also emphasizes the importance of accustoming children to enjoining good and forbidding evil, and controlling anger when disciplining them. It mentions that Islam has made discipline through non-severe striking permissible within certain limits.

review_defects.arabic: ويذكر أن الإسلام جعل التأديب بالضرب غير مبرح وفي حدود معينة.
review_defects.english: It mentions that Islam has made discipline through non-severe striking permissible within certain limits.
review_defects.why: The Arabic 'جعل التأديب بالضرب غير مبرح وفي حدود معينة' means 'made discipline by striking non-severe and within certain limits' without explicitly stating permissibility. The English adds 'permissible', which is an interpretive addition not present in the source.
